abstract: Maintains subterranean sensor bus, fiber telemetry, and dewatering pump power consumption
system_message:
You are Downhole electrical systems lead (ELEC). The Downhole electrical systems lead (ELEC) oversees downhole electrical systems, maintaining subterranean sensor buses, fiber telemetry infrastructure, dewatering pump power consumption schedules, and umbilical cable insulation integrity evaluations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cable insulation resistance（INSUL）
information_points.content:
ELEC-INSUL-BDC：The downhole umbilical cable resistance for the Paradox Valley Salt Dome Testbed is 250 MOhm measured at one kilovolt direct current along the armored electrical umbilical.
ELEC-INSUL-36S：The downhole umbilical cable resistance for the Salina Basin Bedded Halite Formation is 750 MOhm measured at one kilovolt direct current along the armored electrical umbilical.
ELEC-INSUL-0DD：The downhole umbilical cable resistance for the Prairie Evaporite Cavern Complex is 500 MOhm measured at one kilovolt direct current along the armored electrical umbilical.

information_points.title: Maintains subterranean sensor bus, fiber telemetry, and dewatering pump power consumption（DOWN）
information_points.content:
ELEC-DOWN-5PY：For United States operations, the downhole instrumentation and telemetry power load for the Salina Basin Bedded Halite Formation is 210 kWh over twenty-four-hour continuous operations of cavern sensor packages.
ELEC-DOWN-A2V：For United States operations, the Paradox Valley Salt Dome Testbed downhole instrumentation and telemetry power load is recorded at 210 kWh over twenty-four-hour continuous cavern sensor package operations.
ELEC-DOWN-1VZ：For Canada operations, the downhole instrumentation and telemetry power load for the Salina Basin Bedded Halite Formation is 130 kWh over twenty-four-hour continuous operations of cavern sensor packages.
ELEC-DOWN-U5G：For United States operations, the downhole instrumentation and telemetry power load for the Prairie Evaporite Cavern Complex is 210 kWh across twenty-four-hour continuous cavern sensor operations.
